title: Paradoxa, Emblemata, Aenigmata: Dionysius Andreas Freher (PH357)
shelf_note: A c.1720 manuscript emblem book by Freher, the Boehmist theosopher: numbered circular pen emblems with Latin mottoes on the Centre, Unity and Trinity. It belongs on a Christian theosophy / Boehme shelf. The packet gives no tradition or collections to check it against.
structure_note: No structure counts in the packet. All three pages are emblem leaves with OCR but no translation (translation is null on every page), so a reader gets Latin mottoes without English. Emblem numbers 58–60, 81–83 and 135–136 go up with the leaf numbers 36, 45 and 74, so the order is consistent.

The only lapses are a dropped diacritic or two and a model <meta> note. There is no translation yet, so the book is not readable in English.
